en.title: Make the template your product
en.summary: Connect your services, define one useful workflow, and give your first customers a clear place to start.
en.body:
## Start with the job your customer needs done

Authentication, subscriptions, and invitations provide the foundation. Your product still needs a concrete job: create a report, organize a project, or deliver another result your customer values. Choose one workflow and make the path from signing up to that result easy to follow.

Replace the example name, introduction, and plan descriptions together. Tell visitors who the product helps, what they can do, and what the next step is.

## Connect the accounts you own

Configure the frontend and API domains, database, authentication providers, Resend sender, and Stripe catalog for your deployment. Keep private credentials on the backend. The setup guide explains which settings belong on each side.

Keep payments in the provider's test environment while you check the flow. A test payment label in the UI is only a display setting; the backend credentials determine which payment environment is used.

## Check the complete customer journey

Use separate accounts to check signup, the first useful action, a test subscription, and an invitation. Confirm what each account sees when the operation succeeds, is still processing, or fails. Also check the experience on a narrow screen.

Before sharing the site publicly, replace the starter privacy and terms text with your own policies and add a support channel you actually monitor.
en.seo_title: Make the template your product
en.seo_description: Connect your services, define one useful workflow, and give your first customers a clear place to start.

zh.title: 把模板变成你的产品
zh.summary: 接入自己的服务，做好一个有用的业务流程，让第一批用户知道从哪里开始。
zh.body:
## 先确定用户要完成什么

登录、订阅和邀请提供了基础能力。你的产品还需要一个明确的用途：生成报告、管理项目，或者交付其他有价值的结果。先选一个流程，让用户从注册到拿到结果都能顺利完成。

一起替换示例品牌、首页介绍和套餐说明。让访问者清楚知道产品适合谁、能做什么，以及下一步该点哪里。

## 接入你自己的服务账号

为自己的部署配置前端与 API 域名、数据库、登录服务、Resend 发件人和 Stripe 商品。私密凭证放在后端。配置文档会说明前后端各自需要哪些设置。

验证流程时使用支付服务的测试环境。界面上的测试支付提示只是展示设置，实际使用哪个支付环境由后端凭证决定。

## 验证完整的用户体验

使用不同账号验证注册、第一次使用业务功能、测试订阅和邀请。确认每个账号在成功、处理中和失败时看到的内容，并检查小屏幕上的体验。

公开分享网站前，按实际业务完善隐私和条款页面，并配置一个有人处理的支持渠道。

en.title: Know where an invitation stands
en.summary: A shared link, an attributed signup, and a rewarded invitation are three different steps.
en.body:
## Share your personal invitation link

Sign in and open the referral center to copy your link. When another person opens it, the invitation page keeps the code for the sign-in flow. Opening a link alone does not mean an invitation has been attributed or rewarded.

## Follow the status after signup

A pending invitation means the relationship has been recorded and the activation requirement has not yet been met. An activated invitation has met that requirement. An expired invitation passed its activation deadline. The referral center shows the records available to your account.

The starter connects activation to a qualifying subscription event. The operator controls the reward policy and activation window. Check the published rules for the deployment you are using before expecting a reward.

## Test with two separate accounts

Keep the inviter signed in in one browser session. Open the invitation in a separate browser profile and register a new account. Complete the qualifying action in the test payment environment, then refresh the inviter's referral center to check the result.

The starter grants inviter / invitee 20 / 10 credits on signup, and another 20 / 10 on qualifying paid activation. Any product rewards are separate from third-party affiliate commissions the template author may receive from marked service recommendations.

en.seo_description: A shared link, an attributed signup, and a rewarded invitation are three different steps.

zh.title: 看懂每一次邀请的进展
zh.summary: 分享链接、注册归因和获得奖励，是邀请流程里的三个不同阶段。
zh.body:
## 分享你的专属邀请链接

登录后到推荐中心复制专属链接。对方打开链接后，邀请页会保留邀请码供登录流程使用。仅仅打开链接，并不代表已经建立邀请关系或发放奖励。

## 注册之后，查看邀请状态

“待激活”表示邀请关系已经记录，但尚未满足激活条件；“已激活”表示已经满足条件；“已过期”表示超过了激活期限。推荐中心展示与你账号相关的邀请记录。

模板通过符合条件的订阅事件激活邀请。奖励规则和激活期限由站点运营者配置，请以正在使用的站点公布的规则为准。

## 用两个独立账号测试

在一个浏览器会话中保留邀请人登录状态。在另一个浏览器个人资料中打开邀请链接并注册新账号，使用支付测试环境完成符合条件的操作，再刷新邀请人的推荐中心检查结果。

模板在邀请注册成功后给邀请人 20、被邀请人 10 积分；符合条件的首次付费后再各给 20 / 10。站点自定义的奖励与模板作者通过已标注的第三方服务推荐链接获得的佣金是两回事。

en.title: Give your product a place to explain itself
en.summary: Use guides, release notes, and a reachable support channel to answer the questions around your product.
en.body:
## Answer a real question in each article

Start with questions your first users ask: how to get a first result, how credits work, or where to find a subscription invoice. Keep the title specific and put the answer near the start.

The blog stores articles alongside the source code. Each article has a stable URL, a summary, and English and Chinese text. Search matches the article's title, category, summary, and body.

## Describe changes people can use

A useful release note says what changed and where to use it. Keep unfinished ideas in your internal plan. Link to a guide when a change needs more explanation.

## Make help easy to find

Configure a support email or an HTTPS support page. The contact page displays configured channels and otherwise explains that direct support is not yet available. Do not publish an address or response-time promise you do not maintain.

en.title: What is included, and where to find it
en.summary: Explore the public website, customer account center, admin console, and reusable examples.
en.body:
Each part has a different audience. Your customers manage their own accounts; the site owner uses a separate administrator console to run the service.

## Public website

Overview, pricing, setup guide, searchable blog, updates, contact, privacy, and terms pages. Chinese and English copy, sharing metadata, and a sitemap are included.

## Customer account center

The account center at /account, a read-only account information dialog, subscriptions and invoices at /billing, credit history at /credits, and invitations and rewards at /referrals. Email-code login and optional Google/GitHub sign-in connect to the Go API.

## Administrator console

The administrator console has five destinations: overview, users, articles, website settings and audit log. Manage membership, credits, payments and invitations from a user dialog; keep a global payment view for reconciliation. Credentials remain in deployment configuration.

## Examples you can extend

The customer area supplies common account services only. Add your own product feature and connect it to the existing authentication, credit and storage interfaces. Backend note/export and upload code remains available as implementation references, without default frontend pages.

[See what to add before launch](/docs/launch)

en.title: Try a complete customer journey
en.summary: Walk through registration, a Stripe test purchase, and an invitation with two accounts.
en.body:
Registration, customer actions, and invitation records use the backend and its database. Payment testing uses Stripe’s test environment when configured. The isolated local preview keeps temporary data and has payments disabled, so a checkout cannot be completed there.

## Create your first account

Open the account center and use an available sign-in method. With email login, request a code and enter it; a new address creates an account. Open account information to check the read-only email, then try signing out and back in.

## Try a subscription in test mode

Open /pricing, choose monthly or yearly billing and a plan, then continue directly to Checkout. Only after confirming Stripe test mode, use 4242 4242 4242 4242, a future expiry date, and any three-digit CVC. Return to subscriptions to check the result. If payments are unavailable, the owner must configure them first.

## Invite a separate new account

Copy your link from referrals. Open it in a separate browser profile or private window and register with a different email. Check the inviter’s pending record, then have the new account complete a qualifying test purchase and check the activation and reward.

[Start with an account](/account)

[Read the reward conditions](/docs/invitations)

en.title: Connect your frontend and backend
en.summary: Connect the frontend and API domains, prepare environment variables, and configure CORS.
en.body:
The source contains two projects: templates/quickstart-nextjs for the Next.js frontend and templates/quickstart for the Go API. Use both for the full SaaS workflow. Follow their READMEs for the matching runtime, dependency, and database setup.

For local development, copy the frontend .env.example to .env.local and the backend .env.example to .env; also copy the backend deploy/config.yaml.example to deploy/config.yaml. Replace example secrets. For deployment, start from the .env.production.example files and configure your own HTTPS domains and database.

The frontend API address must include /api/v1. The backend CORS origin must match the frontend address. Start the Go API with go run ./cmd/quickstart in its directory, then run npm ci and npm run dev in the frontend directory. OAuth callbacks and Stripe return URLs must use the same configured domains.

```
# Frontend: .env.local
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080/api/v1

# Backend: .env
APP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000
```

[Frontend setup README](https://github.com/brizenchi/go-modules/tree/main/templates/quickstart-nextjs#readme)

[Backend setup README](https://github.com/brizenchi/go-modules/tree/main/templates/quickstart#readme)

en.title: Enable customer sign-in with Resend
en.summary: Set up Resend email delivery and enable the sign-in methods your product needs.
en.body:
Configure the Resend API key and email-code sign-in in the deployment environment. Website settings can manage the verified sender address and name; restart the API after sender changes. Provider keys cannot be edited in the operator console.

Google and GitHub sign-in are optional. Configure their client credentials and callback URLs on the backend when you need them. The frontend shows methods enabled by the API. Verify sign-in, account creation, and sign-out with an email you control before inviting customers.

```
APP_AUTH_EMAIL_ENABLED=true
APP_AUTH_EMAIL_DEBUG=false
APP_EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend
APP_EMAIL_RESEND_API_KEY=<your-resend-api-key>
APP_EMAIL_RESEND_SENDER_EMAIL=<your-verified-sender>
```

[How service settings take effect](/docs/integrations)

zh.summary: 配置管理员账号，了解后台设置与后端环境变量各自负责的内容。

en.title: Configure deployment services and review their status
en.summary: Understand service credentials, configuration overrides, and when a backend restart is needed.
en.body:
Configure the database, JWT, administrator credentials, API domains and provider keys in your deployment environment. Website settings shows provider configuration status and lets you maintain non-secret sender information. Existing installations with database overrides retain compatibility until the operator explicitly migrates those values.

The operator console does not edit provider credentials. Existing database overrides are retained for compatibility; move them to your deployment secret configuration through an explicit operator-controlled migration before removing them.

## Where the settings come from

New installations use deployment configuration for provider credentials. Website settings maintains public identity, support contacts and non-secret sender details. Existing provider overrides keep their previous precedence until explicitly migrated.

## When changes apply

Public branding and article publication refresh through the website cache, usually within one minute of subsequent visits. Sender or deployment credential changes require a backend restart; a configured badge does not prove a successful connection.

## What saving verifies

Status reports configuration, not external API permissions, email delivery or successful charges. Verify delivery and test payments in an isolated test environment. The local preview never activates external email or payments.

```
# First boot only; also configure your database, JWT, admin credentials and domains.
APP_AUTH_ENABLED=true
APP_AUTH_EMAIL_ENABLED=false
APP_AUTH_EMAIL_DEBUG=false
APP_AUTH_GOOGLE_ENABLED=false
APP_AUTH_GITHUB_ENABLED=false
APP_EMAIL_PROVIDER=none
APP_BILLING_ENABLED=false
```

[Open website settings](/admin/settings)

en.title: Connect AI to your own product
en.summary: Connect a model provider on the server and inject it into your own product features.
en.body:
The template supplies a stateless model adapter in foundation/aix and a backend configuration factory in internal/ai. It accepts explicit messages and returns a text completion. There is no default customer chat page, chat API, conversation database or daily usage policy.

Configure a provider supporting the Chat Completions protocol, then create the adapter in your product composition code with the injected HTTP client. Configuration alone does not expose an AI endpoint. Keep the API key on the server and pass the request context into every model call.

Your product owns its prompts, customer authorization, conversation history, task lifecycle and charging policy. Reuse the credit ledger if your feature charges credits; decide when to reserve, charge or refund in that business service. Product-specific screens and workflows are not included in the default customer area.

```
APP_HOST_AI_ENABLED=true
APP_HOST_AI_BASE_URL=https://api.openai.com/v1
APP_HOST_AI_API_KEY=<your-server-side-provider-key>
APP_HOST_AI_MODEL=<your-compatible-chat-model>
APP_HOST_AI_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=1024
```

[Read the adapter and usage example](https://github.com/brizenchi/go-modules/tree/main/foundation/aix)

[Define your product rules](/docs/launch)

en.title: Configure your plans and Stripe
en.summary: Connect Stripe prices and webhooks, test checkout, and prepare for live payments.
en.body:
Create Stripe test products and prices, then configure matching keys, price IDs and the webhook signing secret in the deployment environment. Keep plan descriptions aligned with the catalog, configure the webhook endpoint and Customer Portal, and restart the backend after deployment configuration changes. Website settings shows configuration status without exposing keys.

Use Stripe’s official test card only in its test environment: 4242 4242 4242 4242, a future expiry, and any three-digit CVC. When asked for billing details, complete the required test form fields. A test-mode purchase does not charge a real card.

NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE controls the on-page demo notice only. The backend Stripe credentials determine whether payments are in test or live mode. Missing payment configuration disables checkout; switching to live credentials can create real charges. Complete the test journey before configuring live products and keys.

## After checkout

Return to billing and allow the payment result to sync before refreshing your subscription and invoices. If your plan has not updated, refresh shortly or contact the site owner.

## Test a declined payment

In Stripe test mode only, use 4000 0000 0000 0002 to simulate a declined card. Check that the failed payment does not grant paid access.

```
APP_BILLING_ENABLED=true
APP_BILLING_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_...
APP_BILLING_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_...
APP_BILLING_STRIPE_PRICES_PRO_MONTHLY=price_...
APP_BILLING_STRIPE_PRICES_CREDITS=price_...
```

[Check subscriptions and billing](/billing)

[Get Stripe API keys](https://docs.stripe.com/keys)

[Stripe testing reference](https://docs.stripe.com/testing)

## 购买完成后

en.title: Set invitation rules and verify rewards
en.summary: Configure referral conditions and verify attribution, activation, and credit rewards.
en.body:
Enable referrals with APP_REFERRAL_ENABLED, set APP_REFERRAL_BASE_LINK to your frontend /invite?ref= address, and set the activation window with APP_REFERRAL_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_DAYS. In internal/bootstrap/host_hooks.go, onReferralRegistered grants 20 / 10 credits immediately, and onReferralActivated grants another 20 / 10 on first qualifying payment. Amounts are fixed in code.

A new account created through an invitation starts as pending. Its first qualifying paid subscription or lifetime purchase can activate the invitation. A free trial must convert to a paid subscription; buying a credit pack alone does not qualify. The activation deadline also applies. Each qualifying invitation grants 20 credits to the inviter and 10 to the invitee, once.

Test with two separate accounts and compare the inviter’s referral status and credit history after the qualifying purchase. Publish your reward amount and conditions so customers know what to expect. Third-party affiliate fees the template author may receive from marked recommendations are a separate mechanism.

```
APP_REFERRAL_ENABLED=true
APP_REFERRAL_BASE_LINK=https://app.example.com/invite?ref=
APP_REFERRAL_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_DAYS=30
```

[Open invitations](/referrals)

en.title: What remains before your product launches
en.summary: Add your core business feature and review the customer journey before going live.
en.body:
The template includes basic operational metrics: total users, subscriptions, payments, and invitation records. It does not yet include DAU, retention analysis, or project analytics. Those need your product’s own activity events and project model before they can be measured meaningfully.

The source is free to obtain. Hosting, database, email delivery, and payment-provider usage may have their own costs. Connect accounts you own and choose the services that fit your deployment.

## Deliver your core feature

Give a new customer a clear route from signup to the result you sell. Define which features require a subscription or consume credits.

## Check customer and administrator access

Check signup, sign-in, subscriptions, invoices, invitations, rewards, and logout with separate test accounts. Confirm that ordinary users can only access their own data and cannot enter /admin.

## Publish with your own configuration

Use production configuration for your domains, database, mail, and secrets. Verify the payment environment, complete your public policies and support details, and replace the sample content before opening the product to customers.

zh.title: 上线自己的产品，还需要完成什么
zh.summary: 接入核心业务功能，并在上线前检查完整用户流程与生产配置。
zh.body:
模板已提供基础运营指标，可以查看用户总数、订阅、支付和邀请记录。目前还没有内置 DAU（日活跃用户数）、留存分析或项目数量分析。这些需要先定义你的产品中什么算活跃、什么是项目，再接入对应业务数据。

模板源码免费获取，部署、数据库、邮件发送和支付服务可能产生各自的费用。接入你自己的服务账号，并按实际部署需要选择服务。

让新用户从注册到获得你出售的结果有一条清楚的路径，并定义哪些功能需要订阅、哪些操作消耗积分。

## 验收用户与管理员流程

用独立测试账号验证注册、登录、订阅、账单、邀请、奖励和退出。确认普通用户只能访问自己的数据，不能进入 /admin。

## 使用自己的配置发布

使用适合正式环境的域名、数据库、邮件和密钥配置，确认支付环境，完善公开条款与支持信息，替换示例内容后再向客户开放。

en.title: Email and OAuth login for your SaaS
en.summary: Start with email-code login, optional Google and GitHub sign-in, a read-only account dialog, and a separate administrator login.
en.body:
Customers can create an account with an email code and return to their account center. Google and GitHub sign-in are available when you configure those providers.

## How it works

### Choose an available method

Open the account page. The interface shows the methods enabled by the backend.

### Complete verification

Enter your email code or complete the configured provider flow. A new email account is created after verification.

### Continue your task

Open your account information in a compact dialog to view the read-only sign-in email or sign out. Use the account center for subscriptions, credit history and referrals.

## One identity across the customer journey

The customer account connects subscriptions, credit transactions, purchases, and referrals. It gives your product a place to continue after a visit to a public page.

## Customer and administrator access have different jobs

Customers use their own account center and view a read-only sign-in email in the account dialog. Authorized administrators use a separate console to operate the site; a normal customer login does not grant administrator access.

## Limitations

- Email delivery and OAuth require your own service configuration. Available login methods depend on the providers enabled for this site.
- Team invitations, enterprise SSO, and your product's organization model still need their own implementation.

## Questions

### Do customers need a password?

The supplied customer flow uses email codes or an enabled OAuth provider. The administrator password flow is separate.

### Does downloading the template enable Google login?

No. Register your own OAuth application, configure the backend credentials and callback, and enable the provider before offering it to customers.

zh.title: 为 SaaS 接入邮箱与 OAuth 登录
zh.summary: 从邮箱验证码、可选 Google 与 GitHub 登录、只读账户弹窗和独立管理员登录开始。
zh.body:
用户可通过邮箱验证码创建账号，再进入账户中心。配置对应服务后，还可以使用 Google 和 GitHub 登录。

## 如何使用

### 选择已启用的登录方式

打开账户页，界面会显示后端已启用的登录方式。

### 完成身份验证

输入邮箱验证码，或完成已配置的第三方登录流程。新邮箱通过验证后创建账号。

### 继续刚才的任务

在简洁的账户弹窗中查看只读登录邮箱或退出登录，从账户中心管理订阅、积分与邀请奖励。

## 用同一个账号完成用户流程

账户连接订阅、积分流水、购买和邀请记录，让访客从公开页面进入产品后有明确的操作空间。

## 用户与管理员各自完成自己的任务

用户使用自己的账户中心，在账户弹窗查看只读登录邮箱；获得授权的管理员通过独立后台运营网站。普通用户登录不会获得管理员权限。

## 注意事项

- 邮件发送与 OAuth 需要接入自己的服务配置，可用登录方式以本站启用的服务为准。
- 团队邀请、企业 SSO 和产品自己的组织模型仍需单独实现。

## 常见问题

### 普通用户需要设置密码吗？

模板中的普通用户通过邮箱验证码或已启用的 OAuth 登录；管理员密码登录是独立流程。

### 下载模板后就能直接使用 Google 登录吗？

需要先注册自己的 OAuth 应用，配置后端凭证与回调地址并启用服务，再向用户开放。

en.title: Stripe subscriptions with customer billing controls
en.summary: Explore checkout, plan-change previews, cancellation, reactivation, invoices, and the Stripe Billing Portal in the starter.
en.body:
The starter connects plan selection to Stripe Checkout and a customer billing page. Customers can review their current subscription and see a change preview before confirming a new plan.

## How it works

### Select a configured offer

Choose an available plan and billing period. The prices belong to your future SaaS; the template source itself is free.

### Complete checkout

Continue to Stripe after signing in. Payment events update the subscription; returning from checkout alone is not proof of payment.

### Manage the subscription

Review renewal information, preview a plan change, or use the available cancellation and billing controls.

## Show the effect of a plan change

A preview reports the amount due now, target plan, and whether the change is immediate or at period end. Pending payments and scheduled changes remain visible on the billing page.

## Turn a paid plan into your product's entitlement

Billing provides subscription and membership state. You decide which real features each plan unlocks and enforce those rules in your own product operations.

## Limitations

- Checkout requires configured Stripe products, credentials, and payment events. Purchases are available only when payment services are enabled.
- Refund and dispute events provide extension hooks. They do not automatically reverse product entitlements or credit purchases.

## Questions

### Are the displayed prices the price of the template?

No. The source is free. The pricing page demonstrates offers you can configure for your own customers; hosting and service usage have separate costs.

### Where does a customer change or cancel a plan?

In the subscriptions and billing page after login. Available actions depend on the current subscription and the configured payment provider.

en.title: A credit balance with a transaction history
en.summary: Use the starter's credit service for grants, purchases, expiry, consumption and recorded returns in your own product.
en.body:
Credits connect a customer's balance to individual actions. The starter records where credits came from, when they expire, and which operation consumed them.

## How it works

### Define the paid action

Choose the outcome customers buy and set its credit cost on the server. Your product should display that cost before confirmation.

### Complete the action once

For local database work, the credit service can store the result and charge in one transaction. A retry reuses the same operation identifier.

### Explain the balance change

The customer checks the transaction history. Authorized administrators can review entries and issue a recorded full refund of a consumption.

## A history customers can inspect

A remaining balance alone does not explain what happened. Grants, purchases, spending, expiry, and refunds give customers and operators a shared record to investigate.

## Credit refunds and cash refunds are different

Returning credits restores a recorded consumption. It does not refund a Stripe charge. Decide how your product handles a cash refund, revoked access, and already-spent credits.

## Limitations

- This is a prepaid credit ledger, not a complete metered billing system with usage aggregation and invoices in arrears.
- External AI or other API calls need a separate task and compensation design. Credit reservation, settlement, and partial refunds are not included.

## Questions

### Does retrying a paid export charge again?

Retrying the same successful operation with the same identifier returns its saved result. A new operation is a new purchase; your product must preserve the identifier when retrying.

### Can credits expire?

The service supports grants with an expiry date, and the customer credit page shows expiry information. Publish the expiry rules you choose for your product.

zh.title: 每笔变化都有记录的积分账本

zh.body:
积分将用户余额与具体操作连接起来。模板记录积分来源、到期情况，以及每次消费对应的业务操作。

## 如何使用

### 完成一次业务操作

针对本地数据库操作，积分服务可在同一事务中保存结果并扣分；重试需要复用同一个操作编号。

### 说明余额为什么变化

用户可以查看流水；获得授权的管理员可核对记录，并按消费流水执行有记录的全额积分退回。

## 用户能够核对的消费记录

只有余额不足以解释发生了什么。发放、购买、消费、到期和退回记录，让用户与运营人员可以对照同一份账本排查问题。

## 积分退回与现金退款分别处理

积分退回用于返还一笔已记录的积分消费，不会退还 Stripe 付款。现金退款、权益撤回和已使用积分如何处理，需要由你的产品制定规则。

## 注意事项

- 这是预付积分账本，没有完整的用量汇总与后付费出账系统。
- 外部 AI 等 API 调用需要独立的任务与补偿设计；当前不提供积分预冻结、结算或部分退款。

## 常见问题

### 付费导出重试会再次扣分吗？

使用同一操作编号重试已成功的操作，会返回保存的结果。新操作属于新的消费；产品应在重试时保留原编号。

### 积分可以设置有效期吗？

服务支持发放带到期时间的积分，用户积分页会显示到期信息。上线时应公开自己产品采用的有效期规则。

en.summary: Connect signup, plan selection, subscription state, and customer self-service while adding the core feature your SaaS sells.
en.body:
Use a subscription when customers pay for continued access to a service. The starter supplies the account and billing journey; your product supplies the recurring value.

## How it works

### Name the outcome

Describe the task your customer repeats and what each plan includes. Replace the starter's sample offers with your own.

### Connect billing and access

Configure Stripe, then check membership and resource ownership in the product operations that require paid access.

### Test the full lifecycle

Test successful and failed payments, plan changes, cancellation, and reactivation before offering the service to customers.

## Example: a paid workspace feature

A customer signs in, selects a plan, and gains access to a feature you implement. They later change plans or cancel from billing. This is a proposed product flow, not an additional feature already shipped in the template.

## Keep purchasing and daily work connected

Public feature and pricing pages explain the offer. The workspace completes the task. A visible billing entry lets existing customers manage their plan without going through the public sales journey again.

## Limitations

- The template does not decide your pricing, included seats, usage limits, or feature access policy.
- Payment configuration and your core product must be ready before this becomes a service you can sell.

## Questions

### Can a subscription also use credits?

Both capabilities are available. You must define whether a plan grants credits, how often they are granted, and what happens when a plan changes; do not imply such rules until you implement them.

### Is the example billing page already a complete product?

It is a working billing foundation. Customers still need a useful service, clear entitlements, support, and the policies you will operate.

向客户开放前，验证付款成功与失败、套餐变更、取消和恢复订阅。

## 场景示例：工作台中的会员功能

用户登录、选择套餐后，获得你实现的某项工作台功能。之后可在账单页更换或取消套餐。这是业务接入示例，不代表模板已内置这项额外功能。

en.title: Build a product that charges prepaid credits per action
en.summary: Use a credit balance for individually priced actions, with clear confirmation, transaction records, and defined retry behavior.
en.body:
Prepaid credits fit products where a customer buys a balance and spends it on individual results. Connect your own paid action to the shared credit service.

## How it works

### Price a meaningful unit

Choose what counts as one paid operation, such as one export. Calculate costs on the server and explain the result before confirmation.

### Define success and retry

Store a stable operation identifier and the result. Repeating that operation should return the same result instead of treating a retry as a new purchase.

### Expose the record

Show the remaining balance and a ledger entry so customers can connect a delivered result to its credit cost.

## Prepaid credits are different from monthly usage invoices

The starter accounts for a balance that customers spend. It does not aggregate metered usage and issue an invoice after the billing period. Choose that distinction deliberately when designing your offer.

## For AI jobs, add a real task lifecycle

An external generation request cannot be rolled back by a database transaction. Add durable job state, provider retries, delivery tracking, and a compensation policy before charging for those jobs.

## Limitations

- The shipped service does not include credit reservation, later settlement, partial refunds, or a job queue for external providers.
- A credit purchase still needs configured payment services. The isolated preview can demonstrate spending, but not checkout.

## Questions

### Is an AI generation service included?

A server-side model adapter is included. It makes stateless text requests, without a default chat UI, conversation storage or charging policy. Your product defines its conversations, tasks and credit usage.

### What happens when the balance is insufficient?

The credit service rejects the consumption. Your product should give the customer a clear way to review their balance or purchase more credits when checkout is available.

zh.title: 搭建按操作消耗预付积分的产品
zh.summary: 为单次收费操作接入积分余额、价格确认、流水记录和清楚的重试规则。
zh.body:
用户先获得积分，再按次购买具体结果，适合预付积分模式。可以将自己的收费操作接入共享积分服务。

## 如何使用

### 为明确的业务单位定价

明确什么算一次付费操作，例如一次导出。由服务端决定消耗，在确认前说明用户将获得什么。

### 定义成功与重试

保存稳定的操作编号与结果。同一次操作重试应返回原结果，避免把重试当成新的购买。

### 提供消费记录

显示剩余余额和积分流水，让用户把实际收到的结果与本次消耗对应起来。

## 预付积分与月末按量出账有所区别

模板管理的是用户可消费的积分余额，没有在计费周期结束后汇总用量并出账的流程。设计收费方式时，需要先确定采用哪种模式。

## 接入 AI 任务时，补齐任务流程

数据库事务无法撤回外部生成请求。对这类任务收费前，需要补齐持久化任务状态、服务商重试、结果交付与补偿规则。

## 注意事项

- 已有服务不包含积分预冻结、事后结算、部分退款或外部服务任务队列。
- 购买积分需要已配置的支付服务；隔离预览可以体验消费流程，无法完成支付结账。

## 常见问题

### 模板已经接入 AI 生成服务了吗？

模板包含服务端模型适配器，支持无状态文本请求；默认不提供聊天界面、对话存储或收费规则。对话、任务与积分消费方式由具体产品定义。

### 余额不足时会发生什么？

积分服务会拒绝消费。你的产品应给用户清楚的余额查看入口，并在支付可用时提供购买积分的路径。

Your business service defines the cost and confirms it on the server before recording consumption.

en.title: Use the starter or build from scratch?
en.summary: Compare the included Next.js + Go foundations, customization work, and maintenance responsibilities before choosing how to build.
en.body:
The starter is a practical fit when you want Next.js, Go, and its account and billing patterns. Building from scratch gives you a clean starting point when those choices do not fit your product.

## How it works

### Compare your real requirements

List the authentication, billing, data, and operational workflows you need. Match them to the supplied examples rather than to a feature count.

### Run one complete journey

Try account creation, subscription management and referral rewards. Read the source for the business rules you expect to change.

### Choose what you can maintain

Consider familiarity with the stack, custom integrations, upgrades, and test coverage. There is no universal time or cost saving for every team.

## Authentication and billing

With the starter, adapt connected email login, account pages, Stripe billing, and credit examples. From scratch, you select and implement those flows yourself. In either case, configure your service accounts and verify their behavior.

## Product model and design

The starter provides a public site, customer workspace, and administrator console. You replace its content and add the core feature. From scratch, you control those boundaries from the first design decision and build their foundations too.

## Ongoing costs and responsibility

Free source does not include hosting, a managed database, email delivery, payment fees, or an operations team. Both approaches leave service operation, dependency updates, customer support, and product rules with you.

## Limitations

- This comparison describes this repository and the choice to build your own foundations. It is not a benchmark of other starter kits.
- If you require another stack, enterprise identity, or a different billing model, assess the adaptation work before choosing the starter.

## Questions

### Does the starter include hosting?

No. You obtain the source and deploy your own frontend, API, and database with providers you choose.

### Can I replace the example business?

Yes. Notes and exports demonstrate how to connect a user action to ownership and charging. Your own business feature belongs in the product template.
en.seo_title: Use the starter or build from scratch?
en.seo_description: Compare the included Next.js + Go foundations, customization work, and maintenance responsibilities before choosing how to build.

zh.title: 使用模板，还是从头搭建？
zh.summary: 从已有基础能力、定制工作与维护责任三个方面，比较使用 Next.js + Go 模板和从头开发。
zh.body:
当 Next.js、Go 与模板已有的账户计费方式符合需求时，可以从模板开始。如果这些选择不适合业务，从头搭建能让你按自己的约束设计。

## 如何使用

### 先对照真实需求

列出所需的登录、计费、数据与运营流程，再与模板示例逐项对照。

### 跑通一个完整流程

体验注册、订阅管理与推荐奖励，阅读预计需要修改的业务规则源码。

### 选择能够持续维护的方案

考虑技术栈熟悉度、定制集成、升级与测试覆盖。不同团队的开发时间和成本没有统一答案。

## 登录与计费

使用模板时，可以调整已接通的邮箱登录、账户页、Stripe 计费和积分示例；从头搭建时，需要自行选择并实现这些流程。两种方式都需要配置服务账号并验收行为。

## 产品模型与界面

模板提供公开网站、用户工作台与管理后台，你需要替换内容并增加核心业务。从头搭建时，可以从最初就决定这些边界，同时也需要实现它们的基础。

## 长期费用与责任

免费源码不包含托管、数据库、邮件发送、支付手续费或运营团队。两种方式都需要你负责服务运营、依赖更新、客户支持与业务规则。

## 注意事项

- 本页比较的是当前仓库与自行搭建基础能力两种方式，不是对其他模板的测试排名。
- 如果需要其他技术栈、企业身份系统或不同计费模型，应先评估改造工作再选择。

## 常见问题

### 模板包含托管服务吗？

不包含。你获得源码，再自行选择服务商部署前端、API 与数据库。

### 可以替换示例业务吗？

可以。笔记与导出演示了如何连接用户操作、资源归属和收费，你可以在产品模板中实现自己的业务。
